title: Anki New-Card Suspension Rate
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:review deck=* card_state=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(card_state="suspended",1,0))) as matched by deck
| eval a_suspension_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_suspension_pct
description: Measures the percentage of new Anki cards that end with a suspension by deck.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which deck are helping or hurting new Anki cards.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a suspension` on `language:review` events and summarize the hit rate by `deck`.
visualization: Table of deck with percentage of new Anki cards ending with a suspension.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how often a suspension happens for each deck so you can see where new Anki cards go smoothly or get stuck.
